exposure: Presence of atypical genitalia (undescended testis, hypospadias, bifid scrotum, micropenis)
cohort: The study included eighteen 46,XY DSD patients who presented atypical genitalia at birth and 36 male control individuals.
finding: MiR-210 plasma levels were significantly higher in 46,XY DSD patients with atypical genitalia compared to male control subjects, and positively associated with cryptorchidism and hypospadias within the DSD group.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at the time of the study for miR-210 levels, with atypical genitalia defined as present at birth.
